paragraphs: Mentioned in Bava Batra 111a: he intended to rule in accordance with Rabbi Zecharyah ben HaKatzav. Shmuel told him, “Zecharyah’s view is set aside.”[^1]

notes.text: קיא. gives Bava Batra 111a. The exact William Davidson vocalized Nitai/Shmuel episode explicitly gives Rabbi Zecharyah ben HaKatzav, supporting that title expansion. אפס זכריה is understood as setting aside his view in practice rather than the opaque literal Nothing-Zecharyah. Raw text index 9 explicitly reports Rav and Shmuel saying the halakhah is not according to him; this supports the rejection scope without inventing a broader historical judgment. Nitai’s Rav is full; Shmuel has no added title.
